lines.zh: 四条腿压过灌木，枝叶全都塌了。
lines.en: Four legs crush the brush flat as I pass.

lines.zh: 我的脚步沉得能把松土踩实。
lines.en: My tread is heavy enough to pack loose soil.

lines.zh: 头顶的空冠轻轻晃，走路都带响。
lines.en: My hollow crest sways and whistles as I walk.

lines.zh: 我领着队伍穿过开阔的蕨地。
lines.en: I lead the herd across the open fern flats.

lines.zh: 肩背一摆一摆，慢，但从不偏路。
lines.en: Shoulders roll slowly, yet I never stray.

lines.zh: 长尾巴扫过草尖，替我探后路。
lines.en: My long tail sweeps the grass to check behind.

lines.zh: 每走十步，我停下来咬两片叶子。
lines.en: Every ten steps I halt to nibble two leaves.

lines.zh: 河边泥软，我挑硬地落脚。
lines.en: The river mud is soft, so I pick the firm ground.

lines.zh: 同伴跟在侧后，我的步子放得更缓。
lines.en: Kin follow at my flank, and I slow my pace.

lines.zh: 我绕过那株小树，不去折断它。
lines.en: I step around the sapling instead of breaking it.

lines.zh: 脚掌摊得很宽，走沼泽也不陷。
lines.en: My broad feet keep me from sinking in marsh.

lines.zh: 树林那头有嫩芽，我朝那里挪。
lines.en: Fresh shoots lie beyond the trees, so I head there.

lines.zh: 影子长长地拖在身后，天快晚了。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long behind; evening nears.

lines.zh: 走到空地中央，我停下歇口气。
lines.en: Reaching the clearing, I stop for breath.

lines.zh: 我立在林间，慢慢咀嚼嘴里的叶。
lines.en: I stand in the wood, chewing the leaf I hold.

lines.zh: 喉咙深处嗡一声，冠子像在回话。
lines.en: A hum rises in my throat and the crest answers.

lines.zh: 风穿过空冠，发出低低的哨音。
lines.en: Wind crosses my hollow crest and whistles low.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只让尾巴轻轻摆。
lines.en: I hold still and let only my tail sway.

lines.zh: 阳光晒着背脊，我半闭了眼。
lines.en: Sun on my spine, I half close my eyes.

lines.zh: 低头嗅了嗅地面，我没什么兴趣。
lines.en: I sniff the ground and lose interest.

lines.zh: 站久了，我把重心换到另一侧。
lines.en: Standing long, I shift weight to the other side.

lines.zh: 远处雷声闷闷的，我竖起耳朵。
lines.en: Distant thunder rumbles and I prick my ears.

lines.zh: 林子里安静，我连呼吸都放轻。
lines.en: The wood is quiet, so I breathe shallowly.

lines.zh: 我抖抖脖子，甩掉一只小虫。
lines.en: I twitch my neck to shed a small bug.

lines.zh: 嘴里还有半片叶子，我慢慢磨。
lines.en: Half a leaf remains, and I grind it slowly.

lines.zh: 我侧头听了一会儿水声。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen to the water a while.

lines.zh: 这棵树荫不错，我打算多待会。
lines.en: This shade is good; I plan to linger.

lines.zh: 我轻轻跺脚，赶走脚边的蝇群。
lines.en: I stamp lightly to scatter the flies at my feet.

lines.zh: 我抬头把你从头看到脚。
lines.en: I lift my head and size you up head to toe.

lines.zh: 你比我的腿还矮，我不太在意。
lines.en: You are shorter than my leg; I am unimpressed.

lines.zh: 空冠对着你，我先低鸣了一声。
lines.en: Crest toward you, I give a low call first.

lines.zh: 你手上没有叶子，我就没什么兴趣。
lines.en: No leaves in your hands, so I lose interest.

lines.zh: 我偏着头，看你手里那根棍子。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the stick in your hand.

lines.zh: 你走近，我的尾巴先竖起来。
lines.en: As you approach, my tail lifts first.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，鼻孔里喷出一口气。
lines.en: I watch you and snort a breath.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一丛蕨，谁也不让。
lines.en: We face off across a fern clump, neither yielding.

lines.zh: 你这身高，倒像只小兽。
lines.en: At your height, you look like a small beast.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨了下眼，没打算动。
lines.en: I blink slowly and do not intend to move.

lines.zh: 你身上有草汁味，我闻到了。
lines.en: I catch the smell of crushed grass on you.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，与你平视。
lines.en: I lower my head to meet your eyes.

lines.zh: 我痛得抬起头，叫了一声。
lines.en: Pain jerks my head up and I bellow.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我肩上，我退了半步。
lines.en: The blow lands on my shoulder and I give a step.

lines.zh: 我甩着尾巴，想把痛甩掉。
lines.en: I lash my tail, trying to shake off the pain.

lines.zh: 皮厚也架不住这么打。
lines.en: Even thick hide cannot take this forever.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃脑袋，视线有点散。
lines.en: I shake my head and my sight blurs.

lines.zh: 伤口在侧面，我转不过身去舔。
lines.en: The wound is on my flank and I cannot turn to lick it.

lines.zh: 我低鸣着，把身子缩了一点。
lines.en: I moan low and draw myself in a little.

lines.zh: 这一击让我喘了好几口气。
lines.en: That hit leaves me gasping several breaths.

lines.zh: 我后退，脚下的草被蹭乱了。
lines.en: I back away and scatter the grass underfoot.

lines.zh: 我知道疼，所以更不想退。
lines.en: I know it hurts, which is why I refuse to yield.

lines.zh: 嫩叶的味道飘来，我立刻抬头。
lines.en: The smell of tender leaves lifts my head at once.

lines.zh: 你一摇那束枝叶，我就迈步了。
lines.en: Wave that bundle of leaves and I start walking.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，只要是绿的就行。
lines.en: I am not picky; green is enough.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，凑到你手边。
lines.en: I stretch my neck toward your hand.

lines.zh: 这味道比我脚边的好太多了。
lines.en: It smells far better than what grows at my feet.

lines.zh: 我边吃边走，把叶子拽走半截。
lines.en: I eat while walking and drag half the stem away.

lines.zh: 你可以再靠近点，我不介意。
lines.en: You may come closer; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 蕨叶也好，灌木也好，我都吃。
lines.en: Fern or shrub, I will eat either.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满了，我还在往你手上凑。
lines.en: My mouth is full and I still lean for more.

lines.zh: 吃完这口，我等你再给一把。
lines.en: Once this mouthful is done, I wait for another.

lines.zh: 我被顶得侧了一步，随即站稳。
lines.en: Shoved aside, I plant a foot and steady.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿边，像撞上一根柱子。
lines.en: You hit my leg like hitting a post.

lines.zh: 我低头看看你，没明白发生了什么。
lines.en: I look down at you, puzzled by the bump.

lines.zh: 这么近的距离，我差点踩到你。
lines.en: At this range I nearly step on you.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴甩过来，先道个歉。
lines.en: My tail swings round; consider that an apology.

lines.zh: 让一让，我这体格转不开身。
lines.en: Make way; I cannot turn in this much bulk.

lines.zh: 我被撞得低鸣一声，脚步乱了。
lines.en: The knock draws a low call and scuffs my stride.

lines.zh: 你贴着我肚子走，我有点烦。
lines.en: Walking against my belly is irritating.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一块干地上，太窄了。
lines.en: We crowd one dry patch, and it is too narrow.

lines.zh: 我后退半步，给你留出空隙。
lines.en: I step back half a pace to give you room.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，冠子对着同一个方向。
lines.en: We walk abreast, crests angled the same way.

lines.zh: 它用头蹭我的颈侧，我回蹭一下。
lines.en: It nuzzles my neck and I nuzzle back.

lines.zh: 两只空冠同时响，像一对低音鼓。
lines.en: Two hollow crests sound at once like paired drums.

lines.zh: 我让开草窝，请它先进去。
lines.en: I clear the nest of grass and let it enter first.

lines.zh: 我们互相理着肩上的旧伤。
lines.en: We groom the old scars on each other's shoulders.

lines.zh: 它走远了，我就叫一声把它唤回。
lines.en: When it strays, I call it back.

lines.zh: 头靠着头，我们安静站了很久。
lines.en: Head to head, we stand quietly a long while.

lines.zh: 我替它挡开低垂的树枝。
lines.en: I push a low branch aside for it.

lines.zh: 我们同步迈步，四条腿踏成一个声。
lines.en: We step in time, four feet striking as one.

lines.zh: 它打个喷嚏，我被吓了一跳。
lines.en: It sneezes and startles me.

lines.zh: 我叼起一根嫩枝，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I take a tender twig and chew it slowly.

lines.zh: 叶子卡在牙间，我用舌头推开。
lines.en: A leaf sticks between my teeth and I push it free.

lines.zh: 我拾起掉在地上的果子。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen fruit from the ground.

lines.zh: 我用嘴唇卷起一枝蕨，很小心。
lines.en: I curl my lips around a fern, gently.

lines.zh: 太大块的我咽不下，只好放下。
lines.en: Too big to swallow, so I let it drop.

lines.zh: 我低头把草束咬断带走。
lines.en: I bite through a tuft of grass and carry it off.

lines.zh: 我嚼得很响，汁水顺着下巴流。
lines.en: I chew loudly and juice runs down my chin.

lines.zh: 这东西不新鲜，我吐了出来。
lines.en: This is not fresh, and I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞着叶，说不出话。
lines.en: My mouth is full of leaves, so I say nothing.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把食物推到喉咙里。
lines.en: I slowly work the food back to my throat.

lines.zh: 灌木猛地一动，我立刻抬头。
lines.en: The brush jerks and my head snaps up.

lines.zh: 有什么在树后，我盯住了那里。
lines.en: Something is behind the tree, and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 我先低吼一声，警告它别靠近。
lines.en: I growl low first, warning it to stay back.

lines.zh: 威胁到家门口，我不能装看不见。
lines.en: A threat at my doorstep cannot be ignored.

lines.zh: 我转身面向它，把体重压低。
lines.en: I turn to face it and drop my weight.

lines.zh: 那东西朝幼崽去了，我马上过去。
lines.en: It heads for the young, and I move at once.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那团移动的影子。
lines.en: I lock onto the moving shape.

lines.zh: 风把气味送来，我知道它在哪。
lines.en: The wind carries its scent, and I know where.

lines.zh: 脖子上的肌肉绷紧，我准备好。
lines.en: The muscles in my neck tighten; I am ready.

lines.zh: 它踩着我的草场，这不行。
lines.en: It tramples my grazing ground; that will not do.

lines.zh: 我把头一低，冠子对着它。
lines.en: I dip my head and point the crest at it.

lines.zh: 脚步声近了，我数着它的步频。
lines.en: The steps come closer and I count its rhythm.

lines.zh: 我先叫，让同伴都听见。
lines.en: I call first so the herd can hear.

lines.zh: 草丛里的动静停住，我也停住。
lines.en: The rustle in the grass stops, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我跟着它转，始终用正面朝它。
lines.en: I turn with it, keeping my front to it.

lines.zh: 它绕左，我把身子挪向左。
lines.en: It circles left, and I shift left.

lines.zh: 我压低脖子，准备用头去顶。
lines.en: I lower my neck, ready to drive with my head.

lines.zh: 它每退一步，我就压进一步。
lines.en: For each step it yields, I press one forward.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后扫平了草。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the grass flat behind me.

lines.zh: 呼吸变粗，鼻息喷成白雾。
lines.en: My breath deepens and fogs in the air.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的腿，那里最容易撞。
lines.en: I watch its legs; that is where to hit.

lines.zh: 它停顿，我也停顿，都在等。
lines.en: It pauses, I pause, and both of us wait.

lines.zh: 同伴散开，替我守住侧面。
lines.en: The herd spreads out and guards my flank.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，脚步很重。
lines.en: I close in step by step, each one heavy.

lines.zh: 它想绕后，我抢先转身。
lines.en: It tries to slip behind, so I turn first.

lines.zh: 空地很窄，我不给它跑的空间。
lines.en: The clearing is narrow and I leave it no room.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚着低音，我还没出手。
lines.en: A rumble rolls in my throat; I have not struck yet.

lines.zh: 它退到树边，我停在一臂之外。
lines.en: It backs to a tree and I halt a body-length away.

lines.zh: 只要它再动一下，我就冲。
lines.en: One more move from it and I charge.

lines.zh: 我低头猛顶，把它推得倒退。
lines.en: Head down, I ram it and drive it back.

lines.zh: 前脚重重砸下去，地面一震。
lines.en: My forefoot slams down and the ground jumps.

lines.zh: 尾巴横抽，扫中它的侧腰。
lines.en: My tail whips across and catches its flank.

lines.zh: 我用肩撞过去，靠的是体重。
lines.en: I shoulder into it, and my weight does the work.

lines.zh: 我的冠撞过去，它退了两步。
lines.en: My crest slams home; it staggers back two steps.

lines.zh: 我张嘴咬住，再把它甩开。
lines.en: I bite and then fling it loose.

lines.zh: 踩踏连着两下，它退得更远了。
lines.en: Two stamps in a row, and it retreats farther.

lines.zh: 喘口气，我又把头顶低。
lines.en: I catch my breath and lower my head again.

lines.zh: 我的冠擦过树干，发出闷响。
lines.en: My crest scrapes the trunk with a dull knock.

lines.zh: 打完这一场，我腿都在抖。
lines.en: When the fight ends, my legs are trembling.

lines.zh: 它想跑，我一脚横在前头。
lines.en: It tries to run and I bar the way with a foot.

lines.zh: 我把它顶到灌木里，不再追。
lines.en: I shove it into the brush and stop chasing.

lines.zh: 这一撞用尽力气，我晃了一下。
lines.en: That ram takes all my strength and I sway.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，把嘴边的土吐掉。
lines.en: I shake my head and spit out the dirt.

lines.zh: 我从林线里走出来，踩折了枯枝。
lines.en: I come out of the treeline, snapping dead branches.

lines.zh: 高大的影子投在蕨叶上，那就是我。
lines.en: A tall shadow falls on the ferns, and it is mine.

lines.zh: 这一带的植物，够我吃上几天。
lines.en: The plants here would feed me for days.

lines.zh: 我抬头嗅空气，判断风向。
lines.en: I lift my head and smell the air for wind.

lines.zh: 身后跟来两头同伴，队伍成形了。
lines.en: Two kin fall in behind, and the herd takes shape.

lines.zh: 我落地时四脚齐沉，土都溅了。
lines.en: I land on all fours and soil sprays up.

lines.zh: 陌生的林子，我先把冠子抬高。
lines.en: In a strange wood, I raise my crest first.

lines.zh: 树冠太高，我够不着嫩芽。
lines.en: The canopy is too high for me to reach the shoots.

lines.zh: 我的叫声在林间滚了一圈。
lines.en: My call rolls around the wood and back.

lines.zh: 溪水就在前头，我先去喝一口。
lines.en: A creek lies ahead, and I go drink first.

lines.zh: 这里安静得过分，我不太放心。
lines.en: This quiet is too complete; I am uneasy.

lines.zh: 我侧身挤过两棵树之间的缝。
lines.en: I squeeze between two trunks.

lines.zh: 苔藓软软的，踩下去很舒服。
lines.en: The moss is soft and pleasant underfoot.

lines.zh: 我现在站的这块地，草长得最好。
lines.en: The patch I stand on has the best grass.

lines.zh: 远处有别的大家伙在叫，我回了一声。
lines.en: Something big calls far off and I answer.

lines.zh: 天光从叶缝落下，我眯起眼睛。
lines.en: Light falls through leaves and I squint.

lines.zh: 我一来，附近的小兽全散了。
lines.en: The moment I arrive, the small beasts scatter.

lines.zh: 这条小径正好容我通过。
lines.en: This trail is just wide enough for me.

lines.zh: 火苗燎过皮，我痛得直跺脚。
lines.en: Flame sears my hide and I stamp in pain.

lines.zh: 重重落地，腿骨震得发麻。
lines.en: I land hard and my leg bones go numb.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻孔，我猛地把头抬起。
lines.en: Water floods my nostrils and I jerk my head up.

lines.zh: 炸响掀动我整片身侧，耳朵发闷。
lines.en: The blast rocks my whole flank and muffles my ears.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进皮里，我回头去咬。
lines.en: Something lodges in my hide and I twist to bite it.

lines.zh: 一股冷意钻进骨头，我打了个颤。
lines.en: Cold seeps into my bones and I shudder.

lines.zh: 肚子空得发慌，我连叶子都咬不动。
lines.en: My belly is hollow and I can barely chew.

lines.zh: 雷击顺着背脊滑下，我四腿一软。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my spine and my legs buckle.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我庞大的身子直往下沉。
lines.en: The ground vanishes and my bulk sinks away.
